content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Raleigh

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a specific combination of education and project-management experience. Review the formal prerequisites—typically a bachelor's degree plus documented hours managing projects—before enrolling. Granite PM Academy's advisors can verify your qualifications and clarify any gaps in your background.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Bootcamp. Attend synchronous sessions from anywhere, engage with active certified practitioners, and work through real-world scenarios. This formal education satisfies PMI's mandatory contact-hour requirement for PMP eligibility.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing bootcamp coursework, submit your PMP application directly to PMI, documenting your project experience and education. Pay the examination fee at the time of application. PMI will review and approve your candidacy before you schedule your exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice questions, study guides, and instructor support—to build confidence. Schedule your computer-based exam through Pearson VUE at a testing center or via remote proctoring. Plan your study timeline to reinforce PMBOK concepts covered in bootcamp.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After certification, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) over a three-year renewal cycle to keep your credential active. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing training, webinars, and continuing-education courses to help you sustain and grow your project-management expertise and career value.
